office_does: The auditor records documents, keeps county accounts and runs elections in Jefferson County; four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Lauralee Kiesel, a 21-year Assessor's Office employee, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Longtime Jefferson County Assessor's Office employee (21 years) with banking and small-business experience; the only candidate for auditor.
highlights: 21 years in the Assessor's Office, including budgeting and levy work [S1]
